mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish: current temperatures are at 51 degrees with overcast skies near the Military Ridge State Trail, and we are under a Third Quarter moon. Please note that the International Space Station passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

The City of Verona reminds residents that Pellitteri Waste Systems handles all curbside refuse and recycling. Additionally, please be advised that alternate-side winter parking regulations are in effect from November 20 through April 1 to ensure streets remain clear for emergency vehicles and snow removal.

There is plenty to do around town, including live music at Bailey's Run today, live music at the Wisconsin Brewing Company tomorrow, and yoga classes also available starting tomorrow at Insight Wellness.

In a report regarding notable calls for service, on October 25, a 40-year-old man was taken into custody for a first offence O W I after being located by officers at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue.
Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough, and the store opens today at 10:00 AM to satisfy your craving.
